children.text: возьми все тулы из Blender MCP - https://projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp/src/branch/main и напиши скилл, который научит агента использовать эти тулы. Используй субагента для парсинга всех тулов
prompt: создай "imagen harness" - electron приложение, которое позволит создавать модели с помощью openai agentic SDK и Blender Headless Mode параллельно

imagen harness AC:

- core features
    - tabs. Each tab = 1 workspace = 1 model = 1 blend file on disk
    - workspace. Consist of chat with agent & 3D model viewer

- tabs AC:
    - tab could be created
    - when new tab is created, path to model is specified
    - two options to specify path - plain string or Mac chooser
    - tab could be closed
    - to close the tab, model should already be saved
    - opened tabs should be stored in sqlilte db and be saved on close

- workspace AC:
    - before model being created, user should write first model description
    - input should have multiline input
    - input can take multiple images for modeling
    - workspace should have internal tool for screenshoting and automatically inserting it to input
    - model being created should persist on disk
    - final message from agent should be printed
    - calling tools & small summary of current agent task should be printed, but in one message, with updated text
    - agent should take preview image of model, which should be showed in workspace
    - images of preview should be stored in sqlite db

- 3d model viewer:
    - should contain material slots
    - should provide zoom & pan
    - should provide selection of meshes and gizmo edit tool inside 3d model viewer to adjust model
    - any adjustments should be just for testing and not be persisted to blend file in any ways
    - should provide "reset" button to reset changes

additional AC:
- agent should use same tools as Blender MCP performed through skill
- agent should be openai agentic SDK
- let agent generate necessary images for modeling using imagen codex internal tool
